title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
Around 50°F early, warming to a high of about 62–66°F. Low tonight is near 50°F. Some morning clouds clear to a mostly sunny afternoon. It'll be breezy, with gusts of 20–25 mph. Rain chance is near zero.
What to wear: a light jacket or layers you can take off by afternoon. You won't need an umbrella today, but rain and colder air move in starting Thursday.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms: Democrats have won the House. About 19 races are still uncalled, and the Senate races in Mississippi and Alaska are still too close to call.
• Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Trump says he's sticking with him.
• Ukraine–Russia peace talks have started in Abu Dhabi with the EU taking part. There are early reports of some flexibility on territory.
• A steel factory explosion in western Turkey killed at least 17 people and injured 13.
• NYC: Mayor Mamdani announced a $25M winter plan with 800 more shelter beds, more street outreach and more snow-clearing equipment. This comes as the City Council looks into deaths during last winter's cold snap.

🚇 Getting around
• A train: No service between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park–Lefferts Blvd until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov 16, because of track and switch work near 104 St. Lefferts-bound trains go to Howard Beach–JFK instead.
• 1 train: The southbound bypass at 125 St reportedly runs through mid-December.
• LIRR: New schedules started Nov 9, with special midday weekday service through Nov 20. Rush hours aren't affected.
Check the MTA app before you head out.

🎉 NYC today
• The New York Comedy Festival runs through Sunday, Nov 15, with shows across the city tonight.
• The Union Square Holiday Market opens Thursday, Nov 12, so holiday season is almost here.

💡 Nugget
Tomorrow (Wed, Nov 11) is Veterans Day. Alternate side parking is normally suspended, and banks and post offices close. The Veterans Day Parade is usually on Fifth Avenue, so expect some Midtown street closures. If you need the bank or post office, go today.
